summary: Verified both NEW features + regressions on jhax.ai co-pilot. Backend: added test_chat_stream_sources_event_shape asserting the /api/restaurants/{id}/chat/stream SSE emits {type:'sources'} events whose items are objects containing string 'title' and 'url' (starting with http). Test passed for competitor question in ~54s. Frontend (Playwright, 1440x900): clicked 'The Smoked Barrel' sample -> researching state -> chat view -> snapshot-message auto-appeared and completed streaming. Opened DemoSheet: 10 demo-question items rendered, Q1 disabled (auto-snapshot note), Q2 enabled. Clicking Q2 ('Who are my real competitors nearby...') closed the sheet, appended a user-message bubble, streamed reply that showed search-pill and finally rendered a sources-row with 19 clickable source-link chips displaying clean publisher names (globefeed.com, facebook.com, michelin.com, oddwoodbrewing.com, order.online, austinchronicle.com, reddit.com, toasttab.com, parishbarbecue.com, etc.), each with target=_blank and hrefs pointing to Google's vertexaisearch grounding-redirect URLs (as expected). Regression: chat-input + chat-send-button flow still works (2nd user-message posted after Q2 flow).
critical_code_review_comments: DemoSheet: while snapshot is streaming, ALL demo-questions (including enabled ones) are disabled via the parent-passed `disabled={streaming}` prop. Working as designed, but the Demo button itself is not disabled — a user can open the sheet and see everything greyed out. Consider disabling the Demo button too, or dropping the streaming gate on individual questions and instead queueing the send.
streamEndpoint (api.js): still calls onDone twice on happy path (once on explicit 'done' event, once after loop) — carried over from previous iteration; low priority.

MessageBubble Sources: source-link chips have max-w-[220px] with truncate, but the container is `flex flex-wrap` with 19 chips — layout was fine at 1440px but could get cramped on narrow viewports; visual only.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 including new sources test; only sources test executed in this iteration since prior 14 were green)

seed_data_creation: None (reused existing restaurants via _existing_or_new_rid for backend; used sample 'The Smoked Barrel' via UI which auto-creates one).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live chat with web_search + sources takes ~30-60s; keep timeout>=180s for streams. Sources SSE items are {title,url} objects — url is a Google vertexaisearch redirect (hostname vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com) but title is the clean publisher (e.g. michelin.com). Frontend's Sources component uses s.title || hostname(s.url) so clean labels always show. DemoSheet demo-questions are disabled while `streaming` prop is true — must wait for snapshot streaming to finish before clicking demo items in UI tests.
